speaker: Samantha
text: The bravery, wisdom, and commitment the Chinese astronauts embody will definitely inspire numerous young people to join the lofty cause and set space as the stage to realize their ambitions and the dream of national rejuvenation. There is no limit to the vast universe or to China's space exploration endeavors.
